fields.title: 📖 Salmān al-Fārisī: Fiṭrah against Shirk and the search for the truth
fields.body:
🖋️ **Salmān al-Fārisī** reported about his state before Islām:

***“The people of my village worshipped the piebald horses; I knew that they were upon nothing.”***

And when he later saw another form of worship, he said:

***“This — by Allah — is better than the religion upon which we are.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Salmān recognized, from **Fiṭrah** (natural disposition) and clear **ʿAql** (intellect), that open Shirk and a false religion are not the truth. This is a general disavowal of error and a search for Tawḥīd — yet not a named individual Takfīr upon every person.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Ḥākim, al-Mustadrak ʿalā aṣ-Ṣaḥīḥayn, Kitāb Maʿrifat aṣ-Ṣaḥābah, Dhikr man laqiya Salmān al-Fārisī qabl al-Islām, Bd. 4, S. 790–792, Nr. 6603; Aḥmad, al-Musnad, Nr. 23737 nach Dorar; al-Bayhaqī, as-Sunan al-Kubrā, Nr. 21651. Dorar führt dazu an: Ibn Ḥajar, Taghlīq at-Taʿlīq, 3/266, mit dem Urteil: Isnād ṣaḥīḥ.
